headline: Cal State Bakersfield's November run ends at Oregon State
dek: Cal State Bakersfield won at Utah Valley, the table's leader, and at UC Santa Barbara in November, before losing at Oregon State in its last match. It finishes with seven wins, seven draws and five defeats, more draws than any other side in the conference.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Scoring barely separates the conference's programs, so the table turned on defense: Utah Valley, tied for the fewest goals with 25, conceded sixteen and finished top.

wire.line: Cal State Bakersfield won at Utah Valley and UC Santa Barbara in November, then lost at Oregon State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Scott Williams kept eight shutouts in UC Irvine's goal.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Sacramento State conceded 38 goals, more than Utah Valley and UC Irvine together.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Utah Valley won ten matches and lost three.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five August matches are past their date with no published result, each of them CSUN's or Sacramento State's.

last_match.line: Cal State Bakersfield had won on this same ground in October.
